verdict.rationale: Claude Code itself ships llms.txt files (docs.claude.com/llms.txt, code.claude.com/docs/llms.txt) confirming it is agent-oriented-docs-aware for its own product, and its agentic search/MCP tooling means it can fetch and consume arbitrary web docs including llms.txt if pointed at them via URL fetch or MCP. However, there is no explicit documented feature or first-party guidance describing 'point Claude Code at llms.txt of a third-party site' as a supported workflow. missing for 10: explicit product feature/docs describing consuming arbitrary llms.txt/agent-oriented docs as a first-class capability, independent hands-on confirmation of this specific use case.
